🎤 Why voize? Because we’re more than just a job!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

 

💡 Your Mission: Build the financial engine for our next stage of growth

As an AI-Native Finance Manager, you will play a key role in building and scaling our Finance function as voize continues to grow internationally.

This is a broad, high-ownership role combining FP&A, business partnering, accounting, finance operations, and finance engineering. You will own important financial processes from budgeting and forecasting to management reporting and preparatory accounting, while working closely with teams across the business to turn financial data into better decisions.

At the same time, you'll build a modern, technology-enabled Finance function. You'll connect systems, improve data flows, automate repetitive processes, and leverage AI wherever it can make Finance more efficient and scalable. As we expand internationally, you'll also gain exposure to multiple entities, local GAAPs, and different accounting requirements.

We're looking for someone who enjoys both the numbers and the systems behind them — someone who doesn't just run finance processes, but constantly asks how we can build them better.

 

🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike

  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning, providing clear insights into business performance, risks, and opportunities, and act as a finance business partner to teams across voize.

  • Drive financial reporting and analysis, building models, dashboards, and decision-support tools that help leadership and teams understand performance and make better decisions.

  • Own and improve operational finance processes, including preparatory accounting, invoice and expense workflows, reconciliations, payment processes, and month-end preparation.

  • Build and improve our Finance stack, connecting systems and data, automating recurring processes, and using tools such as Spendesk, ERP/accounting systems, BI tools, and AI to reduce manual work.

  • Support our international growth, working with external accounting partners across countries and gaining exposure to different GAAPs, statutory requirements, and international finance operations.

     

🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table

  • 4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in Finance, FP&A, Controlling, Accounting, or a similar role, with solid accounting knowledge and practical bookkeeping experience.

  • Strong analytical and commercial thinking, with the ability to understand financial drivers, challenge assumptions, and turn numbers into clear recommendations.

  • A strong systems mindset: you enjoy understanding how finance processes, systems, and data fit together and naturally look for ways to make them simpler, more reliable, and scalable.

  • Strong AI & automation capabilities: Hands-on experience using AI and automation to redesign and improve Finance workflows, not just as productivity tools, but to automate repetitive work, improve analysis, and build more scalable processes. Able to identify high-impact use cases and implement practical solutions independently.

  • Modern finance systems & tools: Hands-on experience working with ERP/accounting systems and modern Finance tools. Experience with Spendesk, BI/reporting tools, or workflow automation platforms is a plus.

  • High ownership and a builder mentality: you are comfortable working independently, navigating ambiguity, communicating with stakeholders, and building processes from scratch. Fluent in English and conversational in German.

     

🌱 Growing together - what you can expect at voize

  • We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people

  • We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely across Germany

data.title: Werkstudent IT-Administration & Security (m/w/d)
data.description:
Intro

Hilf mit, das IT-Rückgrat eines der führenden Digital-Health-Unternehmen Deutschlands aufzubauen.


Bei Vivira machst Du weit mehr, als Passwörter zurückzusetzen oder Laptops einzurichten. Als Werkstudent im Bereich IT & Security sorgst Du mit dafür, dass ein schnell wachsendes Digital-Health-Unternehmen in Berlin jeden Tag reibungslos läuft: vom Onboarding neuer Kolleginnen und Kollegen über die Verwaltung moderner SaaS-Anwendungen bis zur Unterstützung unserer Security-Infrastruktur.


Du arbeitest Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen, sammelst praktische Erfahrung in einer modernen, cloudbasierten Umgebung und trägst zu einer Technologie bei, die Tausenden von Patientinnen und Patienten hilft, ihre Rückenschmerzen in den Griff zu bekommen, mit Deutschlands erster dauerhaft erstattungsfähiger Digitaler Gesundheitsanwendung (DiGA).


Wenn Du Informatik (oder ein verwandtes Fach) studierst und echte Praxiserfahrung in IT & Security sammeln willst statt nur eines Praktikumstitels, freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.


Deine Aufgaben umfassen

  • IT-Helpdesk & Technischer Support: Du unterstützt den Vivira IT-Helpdesk und leistest remote sowie vor Ort First-Level-Support bei Software, Tools und allgemeinem Troubleshooting.

  • Infrastruktur vor Ort: Manche Aufgaben lassen sich remote erledigen, regelmäßig bist Du aber in unserem Office im Mindspace Stadtmitte, um bei IT-Hardware und Security-Infrastruktur tatkräftig anzupacken.

  • On- & Offboarding: Du unterstützt das IT-On- und Offboarding, von der physischen Einrichtung des Offices über die Vorbereitung der Hardware für neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen bis zur Rücknahme bei ausscheidenden.

  • SaaS-Administration: Du hilfst bei der Verwaltung verschiedener SaaS-Anwendungen, Benutzerkonten und Zugriffsrechte.

  • Hardware-Wartung: Du kümmerst Dich mit um Reparaturen und Austausch von Geräten, damit unser Team immer gut ausgestattet ist.

  • Netzwerk-Infrastruktur: Du unterstützt das Monitoring unserer Netzwerk-Infrastruktur, inklusive Firewalls, Routern und VPN-Lösungen.

  • Dokumentation: Du hilfst dabei, Systemkonfigurationen, Richtlinien und Prozesse aktuell zu halten.

  • IT-Security: Du unterstützt Security-Initiativen wie Access Management, Endpoint Security, MFA und Device Compliance.


Das lernst Du bei uns

Praxiserfahrung, über die die meisten Studierenden nur in Vorlesungen lesen:

  • Moderne Apple-/macOS-Administration & Endpoint Management (MDM)

  • Cloudbasierte IT-Infrastruktur und SaaS-Administration

  • Identity & Access Management (IAM) und Grundlagen der IT-Security

  • Device Lifecycle Management

  • IT-Betrieb in einem regulierten Digital-Health-Umfeld

  • Support für verteilte, remote-first arbeitende Teams

Du arbeitest mit einem modernen, cloud-first Toolset, darunter MDM für unsere Apple-Flotte, Single Sign-on und IAM, eine führende Productivity Suite sowie aktuelle Endpoint-Security- und Netzwerk-Lösungen. Den kompletten Stack stellen wir Dir im ersten Gespräch vor.


Das solltest Du mitbringen

  • Du bist aktuell in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem anderen technischen Studiengang an einer Hochschule in Berlin oder Umgebung immatrikuliert.

  • Du kannst regelmäßig aus unserem Office im Mindspace Stadtmitte arbeiten, mitten im Zentrum von Berlin.

  • Du hast ein solides Verständnis von macOS und Freude daran, technische Probleme zu lösen.

  • Du interessierst Dich für IT-Administration, Infrastruktur und Informationssicherheit.

  • Du hilfst gerne und kommunizierst freundlich und serviceorientiert.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und proaktiv.

  • Du sprichst fließend Englisch und hast mindestens Deutschkenntnisse auf B1-Niveau, da Du regelmäßig Kolleginnen und Kollegen vor Ort unterstützt.

  • Erste Erfahrung durch eigene Projekte, Praktika oder Studentenjobs (Werkstudent, HiWi, IT-Support) ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.


Das erwartet Dich bei Vivira

  • Vergütung: 16–20 € pro Stunde, je nach Erfahrung

  • Flexibilität: Arbeitszeiten, die sich nach Deinem Vorlesungsplan und Deinen Prüfungsphasen richten.

  • Arbeitsplatz: Arbeite von Zuhause oder aus unserem Berliner HQ in zentraler Lage (Mindspace Stadtmitte), mit hochwertiger Apple-Hardware. 

  • Recharge: Bezahlte Urlaubstage für echte Pausen und neue Energie.

  • Gesundheit: Beweglichkeit und Rückenpower direkt von uns für Dich, mit digitaler Unterstützung, die Du selbst nutzen kannst.

  • Corporate Benefits: Profitiere von exklusiven Vorteilen für Shopping, Technik & mehr.

  • Empfehlungsprämie: Netzwerk teilen lohnt sich. Jede erfolgreiche Empfehlung wird belohnt.

  • Highlights: Mehrere Company- und Team-Events pro Jahr sorgen für Austausch, Spaß und ein echtes Wir-Gefühl.

  • Echte Verantwortung: Ownership ab Tag eins, flache Hierarchien und erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die sich Zeit für Dein Mentoring nehmen.


Gut zu wissen

  • Wie viele Stunden pro Woche? 20 Stunden im Semester, flexibel rund um Dein Studium geplant.

  • Wo ist der Job? In Berlin-Mitte im Mindspace Stadtmitte, mit hybridem Setup: Du arbeitest teils vor Ort, teils remote.

  • Muss ich Deutsch sprechen? Deutsch auf B1-Niveau reicht aus; unsere Arbeitssprache ist Englisch.

  • Brauche ich Berufserfahrung? Nein. Echtes Interesse an IT-Administration und Security plus solide macOS-Kenntnisse sind das, was zählt.

Intro

Rückenprobleme sind der häufigste Grund für Arbeitsunfähigkeit in Deutschland.

Vivira hat die Lösung: Wir machen digitale Bewegungstherapie per App. Immer verfügbar, einfach, wirksam und von der Krankenkasse erstattet. Vivira wurde aus dem Bedürfnis geboren, Muskel-Skelett-Erkrankungen so unkompliziert und effektiv wie möglich zu therapieren.


Deine Aufgaben umfassen

Als Senior Product Manager Digital Health (m/w/d) spielst Du eine zentrale Rolle dabei, unser bestehendes digitales Therapieangebot weiterzuentwickeln und auszubauen. Du treibst maßgeblich voran, wie wir Patient:innen und Ärzt:innen künftig noch besser bei der Behandlung und Reduktion muskuloskelettaler Schmerzen unterstützen können. 

Je nach Erfahrung und aktuellem Fokus übernimmst Du Verantwortung für einen zentralen Produkt- oder Wachstumsbereich entlang unserer Patient:innen-, Therapie- oder Praxis-Journey – als Schnittstelle zwischen medizinischer Relevanz, technischer Machbarkeit, regulatorischen Anforderungen und kommerziellem Erfolg. Dabei konzipierst, validierst und priorisierst Du neue Produkt- und Serviceideen und bereitest diese strukturiert für die Umsetzung vor. 

Deine Arbeit legt den Grundstein für den Ausbau unseres Produkt- und Serviceportfolios, stärkt langfristige Kundenbeziehungen und schafft nachhaltigen Mehrwert – auch über die eigentliche Therapiephase hinaus.


Das solltest Du mitbringen

  • Erfahrung: Mehrjährige, fundierte Erfahrung im Product Management (typischerweise 5+ Jahre), z. B. als Senior, Lead oder Principal Product Manager oder Product Owner, idealerweise im Digital Health, MedTech, DiGA oder ähnliche Bereiche. Du hast einen digitalen Produktbereich eigenständig verantwortet und kannst zeigen, wie Deine Entscheidungen Nutzer:innen- und Business-Outcomes verändert haben.

Wir suchen sowohl erfahrene System Engineers und Consultants als auch technisch starke Nachwuchskräfte, die sich gezielt in die Microsoft-Cloud- und Infrastrukturwelt entwickeln möchten. Entscheidend ist für uns nicht, dass du bereits jedes Produkt beherrschst, sondern dass du technisch fundiert arbeitest, Verantwortung übernehmen willst und dich in Kundenumgebungen sicher bewegst.


Diese spannenden Aufgaben erwarten dich:

  • Du planst, implementierst und modernisierst Microsoft-Infrastrukturen bei unseren Kunden.
  • Du arbeitest mit Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Windows Server, Exchange, Active Directory und Gruppenrichtlinien.
  • Du begleitest Migrationen von lokalen Infrastrukturen in Cloud- oder Hybrid-Umgebungen.
  • Du konzipierst und implementierst moderne Arbeitsplätze mit Intune, Microsoft 365 und Azure Virtual Desktop.
  • Du entwickelst Identity-, Berechtigungs- und Sicherheitskonzepte, unter anderem mit MFA, Conditional Access und Microsoft Defender.
  • Du analysierst bestehende Umgebungen und entwickelst technisch und wirtschaftlich sinnvolle Maßnahmen.
  • Du bindest ergänzende Lösungen für Monitoring, Backup, Security, Automatisierung und Systemmanagement ein – beispielsweise PRTG, NinjaOne oder Hornetsecurity.
  • Du dokumentierst deine Lösungen nachvollziehbar und unterstützt bei komplexen technischen Störungen.
  • Abhängig von deiner Erfahrung übernimmst du eigene Projekte, leitest Workshops und berätst Kunden bei Architektur- und Technologieentscheidungen.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium im IT-Umfeld – oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung.
  • Gute Kenntnisse in mehreren Bereichen der Microsoft-Infrastruktur, zum Beispiel:
  • Microsoft Azure und hybride Cloud-Architekturen
  • Microsoft 365 und Entra ID
  • Windows Server und Active Directory
  • Exchange Online
  • Intune und Endpoint Management
  • Azure Virtual Desktop
  • PowerShell und Automatisierung
  • Grundverständnis für Netzwerke, IT-Sicherheit, Backup und Hochverfügbarkeit.
  • Eine strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise.
  • Freude daran, technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und verständlich zu erklären.
  • Verbindliches Auftreten gegenüber Kunden und Kollegen.
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse für Beratung, Dokumentation und Projektarbeit.

Du musst nicht alle genannten Technologien bereits sicher beherrschen. Wenn du eine gute technische Basis, Lernbereitschaft und echtes Interesse an der Microsoft-Welt mitbringst, entwickeln wir die fehlenden Themen gemeinsam weiter.


Deine neue Firma?

Dich erwarten spannende Aufgaben in einem zukunftsorientierten, inhabergeführten Unternehmen – einem der größten Anbieter mit Hauptsitz in Hannover und einem ambitionierten überregionalen Wachstumskonzept.

Neben dem attraktiven Produktportfolio unterstützt dich im Job sehr wesentlich die inspirierende Zusammenarbeit mit deinen Kollegen. Wir leben Vielfalt, Professionalität und Spaß an unseren Aufgaben.

Wir bieten dir:
  • Enstpanntes Ankommen ... Strukturiertes Onboarding
  • Anspruchsvolle Projekte statt reiner Betriebsaufgaben
  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Vertrauen in deine Expertise – kein Micromanagement
  • Remote-first-Arbeitsmodell: Dein Arbeitsplatz ist dort, wo du am produktivsten bist. Präsenz nur dort, wo sie sinnvoll ist (z. B. Workshops, Teamtage, Kundentermine)
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und echte Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten

data.title: Senior Software Engineer (TypeScript, Next.js / Node.js) (m/f/x)
data.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (TypeScript, Next.js / Node.js) to join our Engineering team in Munich. At Atolls, your role will play a key role in helping us provide a seamless web experience that enables users to find the Smart Shopping capability that best matches their intent through search, navigation, and a personalized home page, creating exceptional user experiences and empowering consumers to make informed and confident shopping decisions. As a key part of our team, you'll be directly involved in building and enhancing the digital destinations our users rely on throughout their shopping journeys.

Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:

  • Design and develop modern architectures using NEXT.JS, AWS technologies, Microservices, NoSQL, and event-driven architectures.
  • Take ownership of solution architecture, improving performance, security, scalability, modularity, and operational efficiency.
  • Drive feature development from inception to delivery, contributing to an ambitious product roadmap.
  • Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions and hands-on exposure to emerging technologies.
  • Foster an open communication culture, encouraging feedback and supporting conflict resolution.

 Your Profile:

  • 6+ years of experience in software development.
  • Proficiency in Next.js / Node.js, with experience building reusable libraries using an atomic design system.
  • Strong foundation in object-oriented programming and concurrent event-based systems.
  • Advanced knowledge of TypeScript, including its environment and type system.
  • Extensive expertise in GraphQL.
  • Keen architectural mindset with an eye for application design patterns.
  • Excellent communication skills with fluency in English (written and spoken).
Desirable Skills:
  • Working knowledge of Apollo GraphQL.
  • Experience with PHP Symfony.
  • Experience working with AWS cloud.
  • Basic understanding of SQL databases and schema-less concepts.
  • Knowledge of E2E testing (e.g., WebdriverIO, Selenium, or similar tools).

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.
#LI-AK1  

At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged.

data.title: Product Engineer — Working Student
Android Engineer - Engagement Mission
Field Marketing Manager
data.description:
About Black Forest Labs

We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We’re creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started.

Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.

Why This Role

FLUX gets attention the moment people see it. Your job is to turn that attention into pipeline.

You'll own two motions where FLUX meets enterprises and partners in person: the events where customers experience the models firsthand, and the co-marketing engine with cloud and distribution partners who bring FLUX to the market. You’ll work directly with GTM, Partnerships, and our creative technologists. Our release cadence means there’s always a new reason to show up. Your job is to make sure we show up well and that every appearance has a number attached to it in order to effectively measure impact.

What you’ll work on

Events

  • Shape BFL's event calendar end-to-end: tier the opportunities, decide where we show up, and run the full events lifecycle: booths, demos, speaker slots, exec briefings, side events, follow up and more

  • Design event experiences that demonstrate the models, not just talk about them; working with Creative Technologists and FDEs on interactive demos and installations

  • Build the pre/post event machine: target lists for Sales, meeting orchestration on-site, pipeline attribution afterward. Every event has a number attached to measure impact (MQL’s)

  • Run BFL-hosted formats: customer dinners, launch events, and executive roundtables in key markets, plus side events at major moments (GTC, research oriented, etc.)

Co-marketing with partners

  • Own the co-marketing motion with our distribution and cloud partners; joint announcements, launch-day amplification, case studies, shared event presence

  • Coordinate partner marketing calendars around BFL launches so every major release lands with multiplied reach

  • Build repeatable co-marketing playbooks per partner tier, and negotiate marketing commitments into partnership conversations alongside the Partnerships team

GTM Enablement

  • Pitch decks

  • Solution marketing

Connecting the motions

  • Co-own the activation calendar with our social marketing team so events, partner moments, and social land together

  • Feed what you learn on the floor (what lands, the questions enterprises actually ask back into GTM and product marketing)

What We're Looking For

  • 3–6 years in field/event marketing, partner marketing, or integrated campaigns at a B2B tech company

  • You've run events end-to-end (from a 10-person exec dinner to a major conference presence) and can show the pipeline they produced

  • You've done co-marketing with large partners

  • You understand enterprise marketing: how buying committees work, what an exec briefing needs to accomplish, why attribution matters

  • 80%+ execution. You can build the run-of-show, brief the booth staff, etc.

  • Strong visual taste: our outputs are judged visually, and so are our activations

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, tight timelines, and launch weeks where everything happens at once

While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience marketing generative AI, creative tooling, or developer-facing infrastructure

  • Existing relationships in the creative AI community

  • Experience working with cloud or platform partners on joint GTM

  • You've built an event or campaign that people in the industry still reference

  • Time spent working in the US, or in a role with significant US market ownership

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. Depending on your location, you’ll either join us in Freiburg or SF at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week), or work remotely with a monthly in-person week to stay connected. We’ll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we’ve structured things to make it accessible to all. We’ll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

Base Annual Salary:

US $160,000- $200,000 + equity
EU €105,000- €130,000 + equity

data.title: Head of Product Marketing
data.description:
We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning.

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

Berlitz is transforming how the world learns languages, moving from a legacy education brand into a modern, digital-first B2B platform. As we roll out the Berlitz App, Compass, and a new credit-based commercial model, we need a Head of Product Marketing to turn that transformation into a story buyers actually believe, and a go-to-market engine that delivers it. Reporting to the CPTO, you'll own positioning, messaging, and enablement for the business, and be the direct link between market reality and our product roadmap.

Your responsibilities

  • Own and evolve segment positioning and messaging (HR, L&D, enterprise vs. SMB) as our product and commercial model transforms, keeping it consistent across every buyer touchpoint.

  • Define the narrative architecture for new products and packaging, including the credit-based commercial model, Berlitz App, and Compass, in partnership with the CPTO and Product leadership.

  • Lead GTM strategy and execution end-to-end for major product and feature launches, directing cross-functional coordination across marketing, sales, and product.

  • Build, manage, and develop the product marketing team, setting standards for output quality and prioritisation.

  • Own the sales enablement library, battlecards, decks, case studies, built globally and localised for major regions.

  • Direct market and competitive research and convert findings into product implications, USPs, and pricing input.

  • Own win/loss analysis as a standing discipline, feeding structured insight into positioning and product planning.

  • Partner with Brand & Activation, ABM, Paid Performance, and Product leadership, and represent product marketing in CPTO-level planning forums.

Who you are

  • You have 10+ years in product marketing, including 3+ years leading or managing a team.

  • You've built and scaled a product marketing function, including sales enablement infrastructure and cross-functional launches at company-wide scale.

  • You write and message at an executive level, translating technical and commercial complexity into buyer value.

  • You're comfortable operating at leadership level across segments and geographies in a global, matrixed organisation, partnering directly with C-suite stakeholders.

  • You're analytical and fluent in using competitive, win/loss, and customer data to inform and defend strategic decisions.

You stand out if...

  • You've worked in HR tech, L&D, language learning, or education.

  • You've operated through a major commercial or platform transformation, such as a system migration, pricing model change, or entity restructuring.

  • You have deep familiarity with ABM and demand generation motions and how product marketing shapes them.

  • You've worked in a global-local model spanning multiple regions, such as DE/EU and North America.

Why you should join

  • Set the positioning and GTM strategy for Berlitz's next-generation B2B, digital-first offering.

  • Partner directly with the CPTO on product and commercial transformation.

  • Build and lead a product marketing team and enablement function from the ground up.

  • Join a collaborative international team shaping how the world learns.

  • Remote work but occasional travel may be required for business engagements or events.

At Berlitz, connecting people across languages and cultures is at the heart of what we do. Our global workplace reflects the diverse world we serve, bringing together different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We create an inclusive environment where everyone has an equal opportunity to belong, contribute and grow.

Ready to shape what’s next? Join us and help build the future with us.

data.title: Senior FP&A Analyst (all genders)
data.description:
About us

At GotPhoto, we are freeing photographers to be more successful.

Through our platforms GotPhoto.com and fotograf.de, we help professional photographers simplify and transform the way they work — from photo management and client communication to ordering and payment processing. Our end-to-end workflow and e-commerce solution gives photographers more time to focus on what matters most: being behind the lens.

Since 2012, we’ve built a sustainable and profitable business driven by entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a deep understanding of photographers’ everyday challenges. Today, thousands of photographers trust our software , creating their own success stories along the way.

As the leading e-commerce engine for professional volume photographers and a business backed by EQT, one of the world’s leading private equity firms, we’re powered by a team of 150+ talented and international people building technology that simplifies photographers’ everyday work and helps them focus on capturing meaningful moments.

Join us on our journey to empower photographers like never before.

Your Role

Do you want to move beyond traditional Excel modeling and define the future of data-driven finance operations?

Are you ready to be a key architect of the financial narrative for a high-growth SaaS business backed by world-class PE investors?

...then you are our perfect match!

Prepare for a steep learning curve and the opportunity to leave a lasting legacy by evolving our FP&A infrastructure for the next stage of scale. This is not a 'run the model and report back' role; we want someone who interrogates the numbers, surfaces the story behind them, and is willing to challenge assumptions at every level of the organisation.

Please note: This is a 12 month maternity cover.

What You'll Do

  • Drive Strategic Visibility: Build, maintain, and present meaningful dashboards and reports (e.g., Monthly Flash, Management Pack, Board Pack) that enable the Board, CFO, and Head of FP&A to monitor performance and take action.

  • Modernize the Stack: Support the migration of our FP&A tool/platform by defining requirements, mapping data flows, validating systems, and training stakeholders.

  • Architect Planning Frameworks: Implement end-to-end forecasting and budgeting templates and processes to enable efficient, accurate quarterly and annual planning cycles.

  • Define the Truth: Partner with the Data team to validate SaaS KPIs, ensuring a single version of truth across all business reporting.

  • Sales & Marketing Partnering: Support pipeline-to-forecast conversion modeling and commission tracking for Sales, while collaborating with Marketing to optimize segment profitability and ROI.

  • Operational Ownership: Manage and forecast global OPEX directly with department heads and support the Accounting team with month-end reviews and ad-hoc strategic business cases.

What You'll Bring

Experience

  • The Foundation: Minimum 4+ years’ experience in FP&A, business finance, or a similar analytical role, ideally within a high-growth SaaS or subscription business.

  • The "Scar Tissue": Proven track record of building complex financial models and managing investor-grade reporting (Private Equity/PE experience is a significant plus).

  • The Builder: Experience with platform/tool migrations (FP&A or ERP systems) and a history of driving process improvements.

Skills

  • Technical Mastery: Highly proficient in Excel/G-Sheets; SQL experience is a plus.

  • AI & Automation: Proven track record of leveraging AI-driven tools and methodologies to streamline analytical workflows and optimize repetitive tasks.

  • SaaS Fluency: Deep understanding of SaaS economics and metrics (ARR, Churn, LTV/CAC).

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written English; German is a bonus but not required.

Mindset

  • The Interrogator: You don't just report numbers; you surface the story behind them and challenge assumptions at every level.

  • The Owner Mindset: You take full ownership of your workstreams and drive change in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

  • Bias to Action: You prefer a "shipped" automated solution over a "perfect" manual one.

  • Keep it Simple: You champion the value of simplicity, identifying process improvements and eliminating non-value-added tasks.

Why You’ll Love Life at GotPhoto

  • Best of Both Worlds: We live and breathe a flexible hybrid model. Our beautiful office at Hausvogteiplatz is our vibrant Berlin hub for collaboration, but you have the freedom to leverage the setup that works best for you.

  • Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We believe in flexibility that respects your lifestyle. Once you have completed your probation, you have the option to work remotely from within Europe for up to 40 days per year. Whether you are visiting family or simply seeking a change of scenery, we support a work-from-anywhere culture that helps you stay inspired.

  • Recharge & Unwind: We value your downtime. You start with 26 days of leave, plus we love to top that up with additional discretionary "X-days" to make sure you’re truly rested.

  • Multicultural & Inclusive Team: We thrive on diverse perspectives. Our international team fosters a culture of mutual respect and professional exchange, ensuring that fresh ideas and tolerance are at the heart of everything we build together.

  • Fuel Your Growth: We’re big on learning. You’ll get a dedicated education budget to explore new ideas and grow professionally.

  • Exclusive Employee Discounts: Get more for your money with access to the "Benefits at Work" platform, offering significant discounts on top global brands.

  • Your Benefits, Your Choice: Through Probonio, you get a monthly budget to spend on what matters to you—whether that’s your public transport pass or other flexible perks that fit your lifestyle.

 

What Matters to Us

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds may refrain from applying for positions if they feel they don't meet all qualifications. We strongly encourage you to apply if you’re interested: we're excited to discover how your distinctive experience can enhance our team!

We work as one team. Wherever you come from. However, you identify. We believe in equal opportunities.

About Bliro

Bei Bliro revolutionieren wir den Arbeitsalltag von Außendienstteams mithilfe von KI. 2.5 Millionen Außendienstler allein in Deutschland verlieren täglich Stunden an manuelle Nachbereitung. Bliro löst genau das - mit Transkription und den KI-Voice-Agents Vicky und Tim, die Kundengespräche vor-und nachbereiten, Besuchsberichte dokumentieren und das CRM in Echtzeit aktualisieren. Per Sprache wird so die gesamte Schreibtischarbeit automatisiert und der Außendienst gesteuert.

Schon heute vertrauen über 2.000 Unternehmen auf Bliro - darunter schnell wachsende Start-ups, etablierte Corporates und mittelständische Unternehmen (z.B. igus, Lanxess und Telefonica Deutschland). Unterstützt von Top-Investoren, suchen wir nun dich als Vollzeitmitglied im Bereich Account Executive (AE), um unser Wachstum weiter voranzutreiben.

Unser Sales Team bringt Erfahrung aus den schnellstwachsenden Software Unternehmen der Welt (Ex-Deel, Ex-Autodesk, Ex-Celonis) und eigenen Unternehmensgründungen mit!

👇 Sieh selbst, was du an Vertriebsteams verkaufen wirst:

🎯 Deine Aufgaben

Als Account Executive bei Bliro verantwortest du den gesamten Sales-Cycle - von der Demo bis zum Abschluss. Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unserem SDR-Team, das deinen Kalender mit qualifizierten Demos füllt, damit du dich auf das konzentrieren kannst, was du am besten kannst: Deals zu closen.

  1. Sales-Prozess führen und gewinnen

  • Du leitest Discovery Calls und maßgeschneiderte Produkt-Demos mit Mid-Market- und Enterprise-Prospects.

  • Du baust starke Beziehungen zu Key Stakeholdern und Entscheider:innen auf.

  • Du steuerst komplexe Sales-Cycles und verhandelst Verträge mit ACVs von 50k€+.

  1. Mit dem gesamten Go-to-Market-Team zusammenarbeiten

  • Du arbeitest eng mit den SDRs zusammen, die deine Termine buchen - für einen reibungslosen Handoff und enge Zusammenarbeit.

  • Arbeite eng mit dem Customer Success Team für reibungslose Handoffs sowie mit Growth zur Schärfung unserer GTM-Strategie.

  • Du teilst Feedback aus dem Feld, um unsere Roadmap mitzugestalten.

  1. Quota übertreffen und Wachstum vorantreiben

  • Du clost konsequent neues Business, um die ambitionierten Ziele zu erreichen - und zu übertreffen.

  • Du baust deine Pipeline in Schlüsselbranchen und -regionen aus.

  • Du positionierst Bliro als vertrauenswürdigen Partner für Kunden, die ihre Vertriebsprozesse mit KI transformieren wollen.

🧠 Dein Profil

Wir suchen motivierte AEs, die für High-Touch-B2B-SaaS-Sales brennen und mit einem kategoriedefinierenden AI-Startup wachsen wollen.

Das solltest du mitbringen:

  • Nachweisliche Erfolge im Abschluss von Mid-Market- und Enterprise-SaaS-Deals (ACVs von 50k€ und mehr).

  • Erfahrung in der Verantwortung des gesamten Sales-Cycles - vom Erstgespräch bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag.

  • Exzellente Kommunikations- und Beziehungsfähigkeiten im Umgang mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern.

  • Hohe Eigenmotivation, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Team-first-Mentalität.

  • Fließende Deutsch- (C2) und Englischkenntnisse (C1+).

Nice to have:

  • Erfahrung mit direkter Exposure zu C-Level, Sales Leadern und IT - nicht nur komplexen Stakeholder-Settings im Allgemeinen.

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an den industriellen Mittelstand in DACH.

💡 Warum Bliro

🚀 Klarer Karrierepfad - kein Blindflug
Bei uns weißt du von Tag 1, wohin die Reise geht. Als AE übernimmst du von Anfang an echte Deals, echte Kunden und echte Verantwortung. Wer kontinuierlich seine Targets hitted, kann sich bei uns in Richtung Senior AE oder Sales Lead weiterentwickeln. Kein Versprechen ins Blaue, sondern ein klarer Plan.

💸 Vergütung + Extras, die sich sehen lassen können
Bei uns bekommst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Fixgehalt, einen variablen Bonus ohne Deckel, VSOPs, Deutschlandticket, Wellpass sowie Essen und Trinken im Office. Dein Einsatz wird direkt belohnt. Learning Budget? Haben wir. Sales-Library? Klar. Persönliches Coaching, das dich aufs nächste Level bringt? Auch dabei.

🌍 30+ Köpfe, 10+ Länder, ein Netzwerk
Bei uns triffst du auf Kreativität und Internationalität. Du arbeitest mit Menschen, die mitdenken, mitlachen und mit dir wachsen wollen. Außerdem bringt unser Team bringt Erfahrung aus den schnellstwachsenden Software-Unternehmen der Welt mit. Dazu profitierst du von unserem starken Netzwerk im Münchner Startup-Ecosystem - mit Verbindungen zu VCs und Gründern.

📍 Office-Lage, die kaum zu toppen ist

Unser Büro sitzt direkt über dem Augustiner Stammhaus - mitten in München. Ob Mittagspause mit Blick auf die Stadt oder schnelles Feierabendbier um die Ecke: bessere Nachbarschaft gibt's kaum.

🥳 Echter Teamspirit, jeden Monat

Wir warten nicht auf den Jahres-Offsite. Bei Bliro gibt's monatliche Team-Events - von Minigolf und Bowling über Burrito Nights bis Pickleball. Spontane Lunches und Coffee Breaks inklusive.

🧑‍💻 Flexibel
9 to 5 ist nicht dein Ding? Kein Problem. Ob vom Küchentisch oder aus dem Office - bei uns zählt das Ergebnis, nicht der Aufenthaltsort. Und ja, auch Pyjamahosen sind im Homeoffice offiziell erlaubt.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 You'll never close alone

Dein Start bei Bliro wird begleitet von einem Buddy, der dich einführt, auffängt und mit Memes versorgt. Wir sind Teamplayer - von Tag eins bis zu deinem ersten erfolgreichen Closing (und darüber hinaus).

Du findest nicht nur die richtigen Menschen für unsere Mission, sondern sorgst auch für eine positive Candidate Experience vom ersten Hallo bis zur Unterschrift. Mit deinem Gespür für Menschen und Prozesse gestaltest du aktiv mit, wie unser Team weiter wächst.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

Was für uns wirklich zählt: Mindset, Energie und der Wille, richtig gut zu werden – egal welchen Hintergrund du mitbringst. Alles andere bringen wir dir bei.

Must-haves:

  • Aktuelle Immatrikulation an einer Hochschule oder Universität (z. B. BWL, Wirtschaftspsychologie, Personalmanagement, Human Resource Management oder ein vergleichbarer Studiengang)

Nice to have:

Noch Fragen?

Steffi freut sich auf deine Nachricht und hilft dir gerne weiter!

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltages verbringen - in Büros im Gewerbegebiet, wo es weit und breit nichts zu Essen gibt, in einer langen Schicht im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Du findest uns auch in der Uni, am Flughafen und im Hotel und überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Durch unsere eigens entwickelte Technologieplattform optimieren wir unsere Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt haben - auf die Umwelt, auf den täglichen Alltag unserer Kunden und auf unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir Gerichte, die übrig bleiben, an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir täglich mit Foodji bereits Tausende Menschen deutschlandweit. Zu unseren Kunden zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal oder Wingcopter.

Und wir fangen gerade erst an: allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns!

Das intuitive und preisgekrönte Audiosystem hat mit seinem kindersicheren, kabellosen und bildschirmfreien Ansatz die Art und Weise verändert, wie kleine Kinder selbstständig spielen und lernen. Teil unseres tonies-Teams zu werden bedeutet, Teil einer inspirierenden Mission zu sein: innovative und bedeutungsvolle Erlebnisse für Kinder auf der ganzen Welt zu schaffen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft des Spielens, Lernens und der Fantasie.

Senior Content and Social Media Manager
data.description:
🚀 About Nivoda

Nivoda is a fast-growing B2B marketplace that is transforming the global diamond and gemstone industry. We connect buyers and sellers across the world, processing $300M+ in annual transactions and unlocking a $350B industry opportunity. We move fast, think big, and care deeply about the businesses and people we serve.

 

🌍 Our Mission

The diamond trading industry has historically been fragmented, opaque, and inaccessible. Nivoda was founded to change that: to empower businesses of all sizes and locations to participate in a fair, efficient global marketplace. Every line of code, every integration, every automation we build brings us closer to that mission.

 
 

🤔 About the Role

We are looking for a Sr. Content and Social Media Manager to own our social channels and be the creative engine behind our marketing campaigns. You are a storyteller first and an operator second: you can take an idea, shape it into something people actually want to watch and share, and make it show up consistently everywhere we publish.

This is a connective role. You will own the content calendar, plan and run campaigns end to end, keep a strong and consistent presence on social, and run our newsletter. You will be the glue across marketing, making sure a campaign lands as one coherent story across social, email, and beyond rather than a set of disconnected posts. As the team grows we will add editorial depth alongside you (long-form writing and podcast production), so you can stay focused on what you do best: social, storytelling, and campaigns that move.

 

What would you be doing?

  • Own Nivoda’s social media channels end to end, from strategy and calendar to publishing and community, with Instagram and our primary channels front and centre.

  • Be the main creative force behind our marketing campaigns: come up with the idea, shape the story, and make it show up consistently across every channel.

  • Own the content calendar and keep every channel in sync, so campaigns land as one coherent story rather than scattered posts.

  • Plan and run campaigns end to end: the brief, the timeline, the assets, the launch, and the follow-through.

  • Run "The Modern Jewellers Playbook", our newsletter. Own the cadence and the sends, and tie it into everything else we are publishing.

  • Turn our bigger content moments, like interviews, launches, and guides, into a steady stream of social-first content that travels.

  • Write social and short-form copy that sounds like a real person and makes independent jewellers stop scrolling.

  • Work with our designer and video partners to ship content that looks as good as it reads, and with our paid marketer to amplify what is working.

  • Be the connective tissue across marketing: link events, campaigns, and content so nothing happens in a silo.

  • Track what performs across channels and use it to sharpen the calendar. Double down on what lands, and drop what does not.

 

What do we need from you?

  • 4+ years running social and content for a brand, with real ownership of channels and campaigns rather than just scheduling posts.

  • You are a storyteller first. You know how to take an idea and make it land as a post, an email, a thread, or a reel.

  • A body of social and campaign work you are proud of, ideally including channels you grew yourself.

  • You can write. Quickly, well, and in a voice that sounds human rather than corporate.

  • Sharp project management. You can run a content calendar and several campaigns at once without dropping any threads.

  • Comfort working hands-on on a small team and building process where none exists.

  • Fluent with the tools of modern social and content work, and happy to lean on AI to move faster.

  • An instinct for what performs, and the discipline to let data settle the debates.

 

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of the jewelry industry

  • Experience marketing to small business owners, retailers, or a trade and craft audience.

  • Hands-on with short-form video: you can shoot and cut a reel yourself, or confidently direct someone who can.

  • Experience running an email or newsletter program.

  • Community-building experience, online or off.

 

Our culture and what we offer

We're a high-growth company in an exponential expansion phase. We move fast, operate with low hierarchy, and give people real ownership from day one. If you want to work somewhere you can genuinely shape things: not just maintain them: Nivoda is the place.

 

Our current benefits

  • 🕐 Flexible working hours and vibrant company culture

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 📈 Opportunities for growth and learning

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 🚀 Chance to join during our exponential expansion phase

Equal Opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let that stop you from applying: we hire for potential and mindset, not just a checklist.

Please submit your CV in English.

 

Not quite the right role?

If this role isn't for you but you're excited about Nivoda, join our Talent Pool and we'll reach out when something's a better fit: nivoda.com/talent-pool

About the Role

We are looking for a Product Marketing Lead to own how Nivoda explains itself: the positioning, the messaging, and the story that makes independent jewellers understand why we are worth switching to. This is the foundation the rest of marketing is built on, from paid campaigns to sales conversations. You will define who we are for, what we say, and why it lands, and then arm the whole go-to-market team to say it consistently.

This is a hands-on role. You will own positioning and messaging, lead the go-to-market for new product launches, sharpen our competitive edge, and build the sales enablement that turns interest into customers.

You will start as a senior individual contributor with real ownership of product marketing end to end. As the company grows there is room to build a function beneath you, but this is a role for a builder who wants to do the work, not just direct it.

 

What would you be doing?

  • Own Nivoda’s positioning and messaging: define who we are for, the problems we solve, and the words we use, and keep them sharp as the business evolves.

  • Lead the go-to-market for product launches. Shape the narrative, coordinate across teams, and make sure new features land with the jewellers they are built for.

  • Build the competitive intelligence that keeps us ahead: understand the alternatives jewellers weigh, and give the team the arguments that win.

  • Arm our sales team with the enablement they need, from one-pagers and decks to talk tracks, so every conversation tells a consistent and compelling story.

  • Own the messaging and narrative on our core product and positioning pages, partnering with the teams who own the website and the signup experience.

  • Shape our pricing and packaging story so the value is obvious and easy to say yes to.

  • Feed clear, tested messaging into demand gen and content, so campaigns ladder up to one coherent point of view without ever feeling like an ad.

  • Ground everything in customer truth: talk to jewellers, run win/loss, and turn what you learn into sharper positioning.

  • Partner closely with product and the growth PM so what we build and how we talk about it stay in lockstep.

 

What do we need from you?

  • 5+ years in product marketing, ideally at a B2B or marketplace company, with a track record of positioning and launches that moved the business.

  • You are a builder. You would rather write the messaging, run the launch, and ship the deck than hand it off.

  • Exceptional writing and storytelling. You can take something complex and make it simple, sharp, and persuasive.

  • A strategic head for positioning: you can define a market, a segment, and a wedge, and defend your choices.

  • Comfort with data and customer research. You start from evidence, not opinion.

  • You work well across functions, especially with sales and product, and you build trust quickly.

  • Comfort as a senior IC on a small team, building process where none exists, with the ambition to grow a function over time.

  • You are AI forward, always testing new tools, and learnings new applications of AI to improve your efficiency and effectiveness

 

Nice to have

data.description:
🚀 About Nivoda

Nivoda is a fast-growing B2B marketplace that is transforming the global diamond and gemstone industry. We connect buyers and sellers across the world, processing $300M+ in annual transactions and unlocking a $350B industry opportunity. We move fast, think big, and care deeply about the businesses and people we serve.

 

🌍 Our Mission

The diamond trading industry has historically been fragmented, opaque, and inaccessible. Nivoda was founded to change that: to empower businesses of all sizes and locations to participate in a fair, efficient global marketplace. Every line of code, every integration, every automation we build brings us closer to that mission.

 
 

About the Role

We are looking for a Growth and Demand Gen Lead to own how Nivoda finds and wins new jewellers. This is a hands-on role for someone who lives in the channels and the numbers. You will run our paid, SEO, and account-based programs yourself, and you will be the person who works out which repeatable, scalable channels actually drive qualified leads, then builds them into an engine.

We do demand gen a particular way. Rather than pushing people to a product page and hoping, we lead with genuine value: free tools, content, and resources that help jewellers run better businesses, and we let that earn the relationship. Your job is to build the acquisition machine around that model and prove, channel by channel, what works.

You will start as an individual contributor with real ownership of the function, working alongside our paid, lifecycle, and GTM engineering talent. As the channels prove out and the work grows, there is a clear path to build and lead a team beneath you.

 

What would you be doing?

  • Own net-new customer acquisition: set the demand-gen strategy, then go and execute it yourself, hands-on, across paid and beyond.

  • Run our paid channels day to day, Google and Meta to start. For now, the ad accounts are something you are in, not something you hand off.

  • Find and build repeatable, scalable channels that drive qualified leads. The goal is a system, not a string of one-off campaigns.

  • Grow our SEO and AEO (answer-engine) presence, so jewellers find us when they are looking for help, not only when we are paying to reach them.

  • Design and run account-based programs aimed at the specific jewellers we most want as customers.

  • Lean into our value-first model: point spend at free tools and content, like our Jeweller Business Health Check, rather than product pages, and build the funnel that turns that attention into signups.

  • Work inside our attribution from day one. Partner with our data and GTM engineering leads so every channel is measurable and every dollar is accountable.

  • Hand qualified leads off cleanly to the SDR team, and close the loop so you know which channels produce customers, not just clicks.

  • Raise the bar on how rigorously the whole team tests and scales growth ideas, wherever those ideas come from.

  • Report on what is working in plain terms, kill what is not, and reinvest in what is.

 

What do we need from you?

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

Develop and Deploy Production-Grade AI Systems 

  • Build, deploy, and maintain scalable APIs that serve AI/ML models in production environments 

  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI solutions, from prototyping to fully productionized systems 

Design Advanced AI Architectures 

  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases 

  • Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Evaluate and select appropriate large language models (LLMs) and foundation models based on specific use cases 

Optimize Performance and Scalability 

  • Continuously optimize model inference for latency, cost efficiency, and throughput at scale 

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to ensure high-performing systems 

Ensure Reliability and Observability 

  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting for deployed models and services 

  • Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance through best practices in production ML systems 

Establish Engineering Best Practices 

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless testing, deployment, and iteration of AI systems 

  • Contribute to evolving engineering standards as the company transitions from rapid experimentation to more structured, scalable operations 

Collaborate Cross-Functionally 

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into core products 

  • Translate business problems into technical solutions and clearly communicate trade-offs 

Drive Structure in a Fast-Paced Environment 

  • Help bring stability and structure to AI development processes during a high-growth, scale-up phase 

  • Balance speed of execution with the need for maintainable, well-documented, and scalable systems 

  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them through to practical, production-ready outcomes

  • Proven experience building and deploying production-grade APIs (preferably with FastAPI; REST/GraphQL experience is a plus)

  • Practical experience designing and working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector) 

  • Experience building AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Solid understanding of model deployment and serving (e.g., vLLM, TGI, or managed endpoints) 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions) 

  • Strong experience working with and processing large-scale text datasets 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience with MLOps platforms such as MLflow or Weights & Biases 

  • Familiarity with cloud AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI) 

  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects 

  • Experience in the sustainability or climate/product domain 

  • Background in B2B SaaS environments 

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment (approximately 100–300 employees)

Key Attributes

data.title: Senior Java Backend Engineer (m/f/x)
data.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior Java Backend Engineer to join our Engineering team in Berlin or remotely from Germany. In this role, you will design, build, and scale high-performance backend systems using modern Java technologies and cloud-native architectures.

You will work on complex systems where reliability, clean architecture, and strong engineering standards matter, helping Atolls build backend services that can support growth across markets and platforms.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

As a Senior Java Backend Engineer, you will:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Java 17 or other recent versions (11+).
  • Build and evolve microservice-based and event-driven architectures
  • Develop APIs using GraphQL
  • Work with Spring Boot and Spring Reactive (WebFlux)
  • Design and optimize data models using MySQL and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB or MongoDB)
  • Ensure high performance, reliability, and scalability of backend systems
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
  • Implement performance testing and end-to-end testing
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, frontend engineers, and DevOps
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and technical best practices
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership when needed
  • Collaborate on AI-enabled features, including prompt engineering and backend integrations

 Your Profile:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in backend development
  • Strong expertise in Java 17 or other recent versions (11+)
  • Extensive experience with Spring Boot and Spring Reactive
  • Solid knowledge of MySQL and experience with NoSQL databases (DynamoDB or MongoDB)
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of microservice architecture and event-driven systems
  • Experience building and consuming GraphQL APIs
  • Proven experience with performance optimization and testing
  • Experience with end-to-end testing strategies
  • Experience with prompt engineering for AI-powered applications
  • Excellent understanding of software design and architectural patterns
  • Ability to design elegant, scalable, and maintainable system architectures
  • Strong communication skills and excellent English proficiency

 Bonus points: 

  • Cloud experience (AWS/GCP/Azure)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience building AI-integrated backend systems

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.
#LI-AK1

At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged.

data.title: Werkstudent:in (m/w/d) Recruiting & Employer Branding
data.description:
Deine Mission

  • Recruiting von Anfang bis Ende: Du bist mittendrin statt nur dabei – du sichtest Bewerbungen, koordinierst Interviews und begleitest Kandidat:innen von der ersten Nachricht bis zum Onboarding. Du erlebst den kompletten Prozess und gestaltest die Candidate Experience aktiv mit.
  • Employer Branding zum Mitgestalten: Du hast Bock, EMPIT als Arbeitgebermarke sichtbarer zu machen? Bei uns wirkst du aktiv mit – ob beim Texten unserer Stellenanzeigen, der Pflege unseres Auftritts auf Kununu oder der Gestaltung eines Onboardings, das neuen Kolleg:innen einen richtig guten Start ermöglicht.
  • Team Events, die in Erinnerung bleiben: Du organisierst mit – von regelmäßigen Team-Lunches bis hin zu unserem Sommerfest, eines der Highlights im EMPIT-Jahr. Du sorgst dafür, dass bei uns nicht nur gearbeitet, sondern auch gefeiert wird.
  • Echtes Teammitglied statt Zuarbeiter: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem HR-Team zusammen und bist von Tag eins an fester Bestandteil des Teams.
  • Eigene Themen, eigene Verantwortung: Du bekommst eigene Projekte, für die DU zuständig bist. Kein Zuarbeiten, sondern echtes Ownership.
  • Übernahme nach dem Studium: Wenn beidseitig alles passt, besteht die Möglichkeit, nach deinem Abschluss fest bei uns einzusteigen.


Was Du bei uns bekommst

  • Urban Sports Club und EGYM Wellpass: Durch unseren Zuschuss kannst du kostengünstig Sport in ganz Deutschland treiben.

Deine Mission

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir für unseren Standort Berlin einen erfahrenen Senior Elektroingenieur (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Analogelektronik und Messtechnik, der mit seinem Know-how unsere Mess- und Inspektionstechnologie technisch weiter voranbringt.

EMPIT ist ein wachsendes Deep-Tech-Unternehmen, das Mess- und Inspektionssysteme für den internationalen Einsatz an kritischer Infrastruktur entwickelt. Mit unseren Technologien machen wir sichtbar, was sonst verborgen bleibt, und leisten damit einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit kritischer Infrastruktur.

In deiner Rolle entwickelst und optimierst du die Elektronik hinter diesen Systemen – von leistungsfähigen Stromversorgungen und Platinen bis hin zur Neukonzeption einzelner Komponenten unserer Signalgeneratoren. Dabei entstehen Lösungen, die kompakt, zuverlässig und für den internationalen Einsatz ausgelegt sind.

  • Signalgeneratoren neu denken: Bestehende Komponenten analysieren, technische Grenzen hinterfragen und neue Lösungen für unsere Signalgeneratoren und Messsysteme entwickeln.
  • Technische Herausforderungen lösen: Fehler systematisch analysieren, Ursachen identifizieren und eigenständig praxistaugliche Lösungen bis zur Umsetzung bringen.

data.title: Software Support Technician
data.description:
About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe’s software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

About Us

CIM Software builds manufacturing and ERP software used by manufacturers across the UK and beyond. Our established products, Cim50 and Cim200, are the recommended manufacturing solutions for Sage 50 and Sage 200. We are also developing Cim360.cloud, a new SaaS ERP platform that takes our manufacturing expertise into the cloud.

We were acquired by Everfield in 2025, which gives us the stability and backing of a larger group while keeping the close-knit, hands-on culture of a specialist software company.

About the Role

This is a varied, hands-on role at the heart of a close-knit support desk. You will be one of the people our direct customers and reseller partners turn to when they need help, taking ownership of 1st and 2nd line cases across our full product range. No two days look quite the same: you will resolve what you can yourself and work with the wider team on the trickier problems, building your product knowledge as you go.

We are looking for someone with solid Sage 200 support experience who wants to broaden across our wider product range over time. There is genuine manufacturing ERP expertise to build here, and a clear path to grow as you develop and as we bring Cim360.cloud to market.

AI tooling is part of how we work, and you will be encouraged to use and build your skills with modern AI assistants as part of the day job.

What you will do

  • Work the incoming support queue, handling 1st and 2nd line cases across our product range for both direct customers and reseller partners, by phone, email, and ticket.

  • Work closely with the rest of the support team, lending your weight across the desk during busier periods to keep response times sharp for customers and partners.

  • Diagnose and resolve issues directly where possible, working from the knowledgebase and your growing product knowledge.

  • Investigate configuration and data issues, including running SQL queries where needed.

  • Escalate the more complex cases clearly, with good detail and reproduction steps.

  • Keep cases updated and communicate clearly with both customers and partners throughout.

  • Contribute to the knowledgebase so common issues become easier to resolve over time.

Who We Are Looking For

  • Solid, demonstrable Sage 200 support experience in a 1st or 2nd line role.

  • Strong customer service skills and clear written and verbal communication.

  • A methodical, calm approach to troubleshooting and case ownership.

  • Comfortable working with databases, with at least basic SQL skills.

Desirable

  • Exposure to Cim200, Sicon Manufacturing, or Sage 200 Manufacturing.

  • Understanding of manufacturing concepts (BOMs, works orders, stock control).

  • Experience supporting Sage or business software, whether in-house, for a software vendor, or at a Sage partner.

  • Confidence using AI tools to investigate issues and draft responses, with the appetite to develop these skills further.

What We Offer

  • Flexible working: office, hybrid, or fully remote to suit you.

  • A varied role spanning our full product range and both direct and partner customers.

  • A clear path to build deep, specialist manufacturing ERP knowledge and progress into more senior support.

  • Genuine opportunity to use, leverage, and skill up in modern AI tooling as a core part of the job, not a side experiment.

  • The backing of the Everfield group alongside a small, expert, close-knit team.

  • An active Employee Council, giving the team a forum to put forward ideas and suggestions and help shape how we improve as a business.

  • Company-subsidised private healthcare scheme.

• 26 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.

• Electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme. Cycle to work scheme.

• Access to our employee benefits and discounts programme.

We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision is made based on skills, qualifications and experiences.
