data.title: Senior Manager, Customer Success
data.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Manager of Customer Success to lead our UKI team within the Large and High Growth segment. Joining our Customer Experience department, you will be responsible for executing our regional CS strategy, driving team performance, and ensuring an exceptional experience for our most strategic UKI customers.

In this role, you will directly manage, coach, and scale a high-performing team of Customer Success Managers (CSMs). Your mission is to operationalise our customer success motions, ensuring your team successfully drives product adoption, value realisation, retention, and expansion across their portfolios.

This role is ideal for an experienced B2B SaaS or Fintech people leader who thrives in fast-paced environments. You should bring a strong execution discipline, a commercial mindset, and a passion for frontline coaching to help your team turn complex customer challenges into simple, impactful solutions.

 

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director, Customer Success (large and high growth) and leading a dedicated regional team of CSMs. The team is highly collaborative and dedicated to retain the largest customers of Pleo. You’ll also have the chance to work closely with UKI commercial team, account managers, customer support, onboarding, product and RevOps to ensure customer risk is addressed early and growth opportunities are maximised

 

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Senior Manager of Customer Success, you will:

  • Lead and coach a team of 10 CSMs, providing active coaching, career development, and daily operational guidance to ensure consistent, high-quality performance.

  • Own your team’s core metrics.

  • Implement and iterate on segment-specific success plans, engagement motions, renewal readiness playbooks, and risk-mitigation strategies.

  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to ensure seamless customer transitions, aligned account strategies, and coordinated execution during renewals and expansion plays.

  • Act as the senior escalation point for UKI strategic accounts, working cross-functionally with Product, Support, and Operations to eliminate friction points.

  • Use operational insights, data dashboards, and forecasting metrics to track team productivity, evaluate portfolio health, and proactively address churn risks.

Immediate priorities you can expect to tackle:

  • Strengthening localised account health visibility and proactive risk intervention.

  • Building high-impact execution habits across your team of 10 CSMs.

  • Improving renewal readiness and commercial handoffs with the UKI Sales teams.

  • Fostering a culture of accountability, continuous feedback, and performance excellence.

 

What You Bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, with a proven track record of 2+ years directly managing high-performing teams in B2B SaaS, fintech, or fast-paced technology environments.

  • Strong experience supporting large, mid-market, or enterprise-level accounts with complex stakeholders and sophisticated commercial needs.

  • A strong commercial acumen - you seamlessly connect day-to-day customer health to retention, expansion, and long-term business value.

  • Deep familiarity with Customer Success methodologies, customer lifecycles, health scoring, and risk mitigation tools.

  • Excellent people leadership skills with a proven ability to hire, inspire, hold accountable, and develop talent.

  • A data-driven approach, comfortable utilising CRM and CS tooling (e.g.Hubspot, Vitally) to drive team performance and forecasting.

  • Fluency in English with exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. Other languages are a plus

Nice to have:

  • Direct experience in fintech, spend management, payments, or financial operations verticals.

  • Experience scaling team structures from smaller cohorts to larger regional pods.

 

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You love combining frontline coaching with commercial strategy

  • You thrive in high-velocity, evolving environment

  • You want to make a highly visible, regional impact

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer a steady, predictable corporate routine

  • You want to step away from the frontline

  • You view Customer Success as purely “customer happiness"

 

How You’ll Develop in this Role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Establish a highly cohesive, high-performing UKI CS team structure for our CSMs.

  • Deliver measurable improvements in UKI customer retention, renewal execution, and expansion pipelines.

  • Build a deep understanding of our product ecosystem to successfully advocate for the needs of our UKI market.

  • Be recognized as a vital execution partner to our Director of CS and a champion for our large and high-growth customer base.

 

Location

Please note: We can hire on a hybrid set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

 

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 mins interview with the hiring manager to deep dive into your experience and what you can bring to the team

  3. Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take-home test to showcase your onboarding strategy and data driven approach and invite you to a 60 mins team interview to present your challenge and to know part of the team

  4. Final Interview: Final conversation with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a Manager, Customer Success, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

data.title: Senior GL Accountant (Fixed Term Contract)
GTM Engineer
data.description:
About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

Go-To-Market at LILT

Go-to-market at LILT is our strategic growth engine. Marketing, Sales Development, Sales, and Revenue Operations run together. We're responsible for telling LILT's story and what makes us different from other translation options in the market. We tell that story to the world with effective demand generation programs, and we turn it into revenue through the outbound and inbound motions our reps run every day. We're shaping how people understand LILT's brand, product, and the category we're building.

We're expert storytellers and operators who work across the entire funnel, from awareness to conversion to expansion. We partner closely with Product and Customer Success to drive pipeline, accelerate adoption, and position LILT as the market leader in enterprise AI translation.

This role has a cross-functional mandate by design. The systems that matter most right now sit on the Sales and RevOps side as much as the Marketing side: Account routing, the lead-to-opportunity process, ADR-facing tooling, signal scanning for the reps. You'll have explicit standing to audit, redesign, and rebuild AI workflows across all of our growth systems.

We're building a world-class team and we're looking for ambitious, curious people who want to grow fast, work with seasoned operators, and help shape the future of AI and language.

Whether it's crafting compelling narratives, launching new capabilities, running high-impact campaigns, or engineering the systems underneath all of it, we move fast, think big, and care deeply about quality. If you're excited about AI, language, and building a category-defining company, you'll thrive here. It's a place to work if you want to have a real impact, learn a ton, working hands-on building content, campaigns, programs, and systems you can be proud of.

GTM Engineering at LILT

As LILT scales, more of our go-to-market motion is powered by agentic AI, systems that can research, enrich, sequence, and act on our behalf, not just report on what already happened. This role sits at the center of that shift. You'll be the builder who turns "we should automate this" into a working, reliable system, owning the tools and automations that keep Marketing, Sales, and RevOps running smoothly.

Examples of the kinds of systems that live in this role:

  • AI-driven meeting and lead qualification agents that compile evidence from across our stack to make a judgment

  • Account signal-scoring systems that combine data into a ranked, defensible view of where the team should spend its time

  • AI-drafted outbound at scale, personalized from live account context

These are illustrative rather than a fixed backlog. The specific builds will change; the shape of the work won't.

Where You'll Work

This role is based in our London office. We work in a hybrid model, with team members in the office 3 days per week to collaborate, brainstorm, and build together. You'll get the energy and creativity of in-person work, combined with the flexibility to focus from home when needed.

What You'll Do

This high-impact, hands-on role is responsible for owning LILT's agentic GTM systems: proposing, designing, building, and maintaining the AI-driven tools and automations that power our go-to-market engine, including our Clay-based enrichment and outbound workflows. You'll also play a critical role in optimizing our go-to-market technology stack, streamlining our lead-to-opportunity process, and helping to maintain day-to-day department operations.

You'll work closely with GTM leadership across Sales Development, Sales, Marketing, and Operations and Systems functions to drive process optimization and overall efficiency. You'll recommend, build, and run cross-functional projects and process improvements that directly impact our operational efficiency and top-line growth of all revenue lines. You'll contribute to the strategy and execution of full-funnel programs that drive predictable, scalable pipeline.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Agentic business systems integration. Propose, design, build, and maintain agentic AI tools and automations that connect and orchestrate our GTM stack end-to-end, reducing manual work and increasing the speed and reliability of our lead-to-revenue motion.

  • Own Clay and the automation stack. Serve as our resident expert on Clay (and similar enrichment/orchestration tools), building and maintaining tables, waterfalls, and workflows that keep our data accurate and our outbound motion running.

  • Salesforce lead-to-opportunity. Partner closely with RevOps to own the workflow from a new lead entering the system, through the various lead stages, and converting to an opportunity, including routing, assignment, and the rules that decide who works what.

  • Full-funnel ownership. Design and optimize the entire lead funnel, from top-of-funnel acquisition through MQL to SQL handoff, driving higher conversion and increased velocity.

  • Lead and contact data integrity. Work with internal tools and external vendors to maintain a high quality database of contacts across our target industries and personas.

  • Partner with Sales. Align tightly with revenue leadership to define pipeline goals, campaign targeting, SLAs, and lead management workflows. Sit close enough to the reps to know which parts of the process actually hurt.

  • Fuel growth. Partner closely with the demand gen team to drive multi-channel campaigns across email marketing, webinars, paid media, SEO, events, outbound motions, and ABM to meet ambitious growth targets.

  • Use data to scale. Build a data-driven culture. Forecast, measure, and communicate program results, continuously optimizing for ROI and CAC efficiency.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally. Work across demand gen, product marketing, ADRs, and sales ops to build cohesive, conversion-optimized systems and campaigns.

  • Department operations. Help with department-level planning for things like managing campaign budget, team meetings and activities, and annual planning.

  • Documentation and knowledge continuity. Maintain living documentation (Notion) for every agent and workflow you own, to a standard where a new team member or another AI agent could pick up ownership without a live handover call. This is a stated expectation of the role, not an afterthought.

Our Stack

  • CRM and RevOps: Salesforce, Default

  • Enrichment and orchestration: Clay, ZoomInfo

  • Outbound and conversation intelligence: Amplemarket, Trellus

  • Inbound and web conversion: Qualified

  • Marketing automation: HubSpot

  • Analytics: GA4, Salesforce reporting, Looker Studio

  • Build environment: Python, LLM APIs, agentic coding tools, Notion for documentation

Skills and Experience

  • 3-5 years in B2B SaaS or AI/ML go-to-market engineering, RevOps, or marketing operations, with a track record of building automations that actually ship.

  • Hands-on Clay expertise. You've built waterfall enrichment, scoring, and routing in Clay (or a comparable tool), and you can take a new use case from idea to live quickly.

  • Agentic AI and automation fluency. Comfortable proposing, designing, and building agentic workflows and integrations using APIs, webhooks, and orchestration tools, to connect systems and eliminate manual work.

  • Working proficiency in Python/other languages for building and maintaining AI agent pipelines. Comfortable working inside an existing codebase, not just writing standalone scripts.

  • Comfortable reasoning about tradeoffs under cost and token constraints. You can explain not just what you built, but why you didn't build the more expensive or more complex version.

  • Strong Salesforce fundamentals. You can build reports, understand the object model and the automation layer, and use what you find to change how the funnel actually performs.

  • A point of view on where AI in GTM is heading. We'll ask. We're less interested in whether we agree than in whether you've thought about it seriously.

  • Obsessed with the metrics that matter: MQLs, pipeline, bookings, funnel conversion, velocity, CAC, and ROI.

  • Familiarity with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot or similar) a plus.

  • Ability to build relationships and work cross-functionally.

  • Smart, curious, and hard-working.

  • Natural collaborator and communicator, comfortable presenting to executives, boards, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review


LILT in the News

  • Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!

  • LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List.

  • LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

  • Check out all our news on our website.

data.title: Director of Systems Delivery
data.description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.
 
Our team of 100+ is based in Oxford and London, with a centre of mass in our Islington lab.


Functions of the Role

As Director of Systems Delivery, you will build and lead the function responsible for the complete lifecycle of Quantum Motion’s full-stack silicon quantum systems, from initial programme planning, build, and integration through commissioning, acceptance testing, and handover. 

You will drive cross-functional alignment across hardware, software, systems integration, and operations. Key priorities include establishing delivery playbooks, acceptance protocols, and customer site infrastructure readiness, while synchronising complex silicon bring-up with agile software developments.

We are seeking a pragmatic leader with proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams to deploy first-of-a-kind, deep-tech systems into field environments. Direct hardware experience in silicon, semiconductor, or advanced physical instrumentation is mandatory; you must understand physical build constraints, microelectronics/systems integration, and environmental facility requirements.

  • Full-Stack System Execution: Lead the Systems Delivery capability to execute internal full-stack system deployments, bridging physical hardware with full-stack software from assembly through customer handover.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinate across hardware, software, product, and operations teams to align physical hardware build schedules with software release cycles, managing dependency interfaces and trade-offs.

  • Site Infrastructure Readiness: Oversee internal and customer site infrastructure preparation to ensure physical environments are ready for deployment.

  • Acceptance Testing & Governance: Implement delivery schedules, risk management, and formal acceptance testing protocols.

  • Service & Operational Handoff: Establish post-installation support frameworks, handovers, and field engineering processes to guarantee long-term operational uptime.

  • Process Standardisation: Build scalable playbooks, quality standards, and repeatable processes for integration, validation, and operational readiness. 

  • Supply Chain Management: Manage technical hardware procurement, key vendor relationships, and supplier performance supporting delivery timelines.                                                                  

  • Commercial Scoping Support: Provide technical scoping, feasibility input, and operational planning for commercial proposals while fostering team accountability.


Experience - Essentials

  • Must have proven experience managing physical hardware systems (e.g., quantum, semiconductor, aerospace, or advanced scientific instrumentation) with a realistic understanding of physical build constraints and lead times.

  • Demonstrated background managing hardware-software integration, physical systems validation, and site-installation constraints.

  • Experience building, managing, and mentoring hardware, systems integration, or field delivery teams.

  • Track record of taking first-of-a-kind physical hardware platforms from prototype to repeatable deployment models.

  • Hands-on experience managing facility readiness and running structured customer acceptance protocols.

  • Strong project management expertise tracking HW/SW critical paths, project budgets, risk registers, and executive reporting.

  • Direct experience overseeing technical vendors, supplier selection, and component procurement.

  • Strong communication skills with key stakeholders, including executive, technical, and customer audiences. Willingness and eligibility to travel internationally to customer sites as required.


Experience - Desirable

  • Direct technical background in quantum computing systems, cryogenic systems, silicon platforms, or HPC architectures.

  • Experience establishing post-delivery field support, service handoffs, or customer support operations for complex hardware.

  • Experience scaling system assembly and delivery operations within a deep-tech environment. Experience supporting hardware/software technical scoping for commercial proposals.


Benefits

  • Be part of a creative, world-leading team

  • Competitive salary and share options scheme

  • Contributory pension scheme

  • Group private medical insurance scheme

  • Life Assurance

  • Cycle-to-work Scheme 

  • Central London location


EEO Statement

  • Interdisciplinary openness: Readiness to collaborate with colleagues in applied computing and AI, digital business transformation, and immersive design

What we offer

  • The opportunity to shape the development of a new university and its programmes right from its foundation.

  • Regular team events and shared experiences
  • Plenty of autonomy, varied responsibilities, and a culture that encourages new ideas and innovation

data.title: Atlassian Senior Consultant - ITSM/ESM Practice
data.description:
About Valiantys

Valiantys helps organizations transform how work gets done across the enterprise, leading with transformation consulting, enterprise service management (ESM), and engineering productivity. By combining deep process expertise with modern collaboration, automation, and value stream practices, Valiantys enables business, IT, and product teams to design connected, efficient, and human-centered ways of working. With a strong focus on the modern workforce, the company helps customers reimagine service delivery beyond IT, streamline cross-functional workflows, and improve flow and throughput for engineering teams. For more information, visit https://valiantys.com.


Job Summary

As a Senior Solution Consultant – ITSM, you will act as a trusted advisor to our customers, helping them translate business and service management challenges into practical, scalable solutions built on Atlassian tools and industry best practices.

You will lead discovery and solution design, guide customers through ITSM transformation, and own the solution intent throughout delivery. Working closely with Technical Consultants, Technical Architects, Project Managers, Engagement Managers, and Sales, you will ensure solutions remain feasible, aligned with customer needs, and focused on measurable outcomes.

 

What You’ll Be Working On

Discover & Advise

  • Lead discovery and scoping workshops to understand customer objectives, pain points, processes, constraints, maturity, and desired outcomes
  • Analyze and challenge existing service management processes and recommend practical improvements based on ITSM and Atlassian leading practices
  • Translate customer requirements into solution themes, priorities, success measures, and implementation considerations
  • Advise customers across ITSM practices such as incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset and configuration management, service portals, and service operations
  • Facilitate conversations with business and technical stakeholders and identify where additional specialist expertise is required

    • Design & Shape Solutions

    • Translate business needs into high-level solution designs, roadmaps, configuration blueprints, and implementation-ready recommendations
    • Design scalable ITSM solutions leveraging Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian ecosystem
    • Produce clear deliverables including discovery outputs, current-state and future-state process maps, Solution Design Documents, requirements, acceptance criteria, decision logs, and requirements traceability
    • Document assumptions, dependencies, design decisions, trade-offs, and unresolved questions to maintain a shared understanding of the solution
    • Collaborate with Technical Consultants and Technical Architects to validate feasibility, scalability, integrations, automation, reporting, and platform constraints

      • Own & Guide Delivery

      • Own the solution intent throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring requirements, design decisions, acceptance criteria, and business outcomes remain visible during delivery
      • Support delivery teams by clarifying business context, requirements, design rationale, and customer priorities when questions or trade-offs arise
      • Facilitate solution checkpoints, design reviews, and working sessions with business and technical stakeholders
      • Partner with Project Managers and Technical Leads to maintain alignment between the approved solution design and delivered outcomes
      • Help ensure solutions remain appropriate for the customer’s maturity, constraints, and stated success measures

        • Support Pre-Sales & Client Growth

        • Support pre-sales activities with discovery insights, solution recommendations, effort assumptions, delivery considerations, and scope clarification
        • Contribute to proposals and Statements of Work where solution design, assumptions, acceptance criteria, dependencies, or delivery risks need to be clarified
        • Identify gaps, risks, dependencies, and scope boundaries before opportunities transition into delivery
        • Build and maintain trusted customer relationships throughout the engagement lifecycle
        • Identify opportunities for optimization, expansion, or follow-on advisory work and collaborate with the appropriate Sales or Engagement owner

          • Contribute & Grow

          • Mentor Consultants on discovery, advisory practices, solution documentation, and customer-facing communication
          • Contribute to internal playbooks, discovery frameworks, reusable ITSM solution assets, process maps, and delivery templates
          • Share knowledge and leading practices across the Solution Consulting and wider Delivery teams
          • Use approved AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, documentation, synthesis, quality review, and knowledge reuse while ensuring outputs remain accurate and customer-specific
          • Stay current with developments across the Atlassian ecosystem and trends in ITSM, ESM, Agile, Work Management, automation, reporting, and enterprise collaboration
          • Maintain and develop your expertise through continuous learning and relevant certifications
 

Do You Have What It Takes?

To succeed in this role, you bring:

  • Significant experience in ITSM consulting, solution consulting, or service management transformation
  • Strong knowledge of Jira Service Management and the Atlassian ecosystem
  • Demonstrated experience leading customer discovery, requirements, and solution design workshops
  • Strong understanding of ITSM practices, including incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset and configuration management
  • Experience translating complex business requirements into practical solution designs and implementation recommendations
  • Experience producing high-quality customer-facing solution documentation, process maps, requirements, and acceptance criteria
  • Ability to balance customer expectations, business outcomes, platform capabilities, technical constraints, and delivery realities
  • Experience collaborating with technical consultants, architects, project managers, and commercial teams
  • Experience mentoring or supporting the development of less experienced consultants
  • Atlassian and/or ITIL certifications are a plus

    • Your strengths

    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
    • Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management abilities
    • Ability to engage confidently with both business and technical stakeholders
    • Consultative mindset with the ability to challenge constructively and influence decisions
    • Ability to simplify complex requirements and turn them into clear, actionable solutions
    • Strong sense of ownership while working collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams
    • Proactive and pragmatic approach to solving customer challenges
    • Attention to detail and commitment to high-quality deliverables
    • Customer-focused approach with a strong orientation toward measurable outcomes
    • Ability to mentor and support the growth of other consultants

      • Why Join Valiantys?

      At Valiantys, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make an impact.

      Meaning : Drive strategic transformation projects and influence outcomes
      Learning : Continuous development through training, certifications, and communities
      Flexibility : Hybrid work model supporting work-life balance

      Additional benefits:

      • International and multicultural environment
      • Flexible remote work policy
      • Meal vouchers
      • 100% covered health insurance (for you and your family)
      • Choice of equipment (PC or Mac)
      • Supportive and collaborative culture

        • Valiantys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to personal background, identity, or beliefs.

data.description:
About Relation

Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure.

We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact.

We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age.

By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients.

 

The opportunity

As Associate Director, Platform Engineering, you will lead the team responsible for the hybrid compute infrastructure, developer platform and scientific compute environments that power Relation’s machine learning and drug discovery work. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you will work closely with your team and peers across Engineering, Data Science and Machine Learning to define and evolve Relation’s platform strategy.

Our platform spans on-premises infrastructure and public cloud environments, supporting computational scientist notebooks through Kubeflow, model training and serving, internal services and genomic pipelines. You will set the technical direction across these areas, build and develop the team responsible for delivering them, and ensure our platform continues to evolve alongside the needs of our science.

Day to day, you will

  • Partner with the VP of Engineering and peers across Engineering, Data Science and Machine Learning to define and evolve Relation’s platform strategy.

  • Own the architectural strategy for our Kubernetes-based clusters and broader hybrid infrastructure, setting the technical standards and guardrails within which the team designs, builds and operates.

  • Lead and develop the Platform Engineering team, hiring and retaining exceptional engineers, setting clear expectations and creating the conditions for them to do their best work.

  • Own the scientific compute platform, ensuring it reliably and efficiently meets the evolving needs of our Machine Learning and Data Science teams.

  • Drive the maturity of our CI/CD pipelines, internal services and developer tooling, treating the platform as a product and our internal engineers and computational scientists as its customers.

  • Establish comprehensive observability and robust disaster recovery and failover strategies across on-premises and cloud environments.

  • Own Relation’s platform security controls, including IAM, secrets management, network policy and vulnerability management, ensuring the platform meets the data governance standards required of a clinical-stage biotech working with sensitive patient-derived data.

 

Professionally, you will have

  • Significant experience in platform, infrastructure or DevOps engineering, with a strong track record of building and operating complex production environments.

  • Experience leading engineers, either formally or informally, with responsibility for significant workstreams from strategy through to delivery. You have set technical direction others have followed, mentored and developed engineers, and taken accountability for live production systems.

  • Strong hands-on operational experience. You have participated in on-call rotations for production infrastructure, led responses to significant incidents and driven the subsequent changes required to prevent recurrence.

  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes, alongside experience operating infrastructure across hybrid on-premises and cloud environments.

  • Experience building, running or evolving MLOps infrastructure, ideally including notebook environments such as Kubeflow, GPU compute for distributed training and model serving.

  • Familiarity with batch compute for data-intensive scientific workloads, with an understanding of the reliability, scalability and reproducibility requirements of scientific data pipelines.

  • A track record of maturing CI/CD pipelines, developer tooling and observability across complex, multi-environment platforms.

  • Strong security fundamentals, with hands-on experience designing and implementing appropriate security controls.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to co-own strategy with senior stakeholders, challenge decisions constructively and communicate platform strategy clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Bonus Experience:

  • Exposure to relevant compliance and governance frameworks, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or GDPR within a research or scientific environment.

 

Personally, you

  • Are comfortable working in a matrixed environment, balancing multiple stakeholders and contributing effectively across teams.

  • Take ownership of your work, proactively seek opportunities to contribute, and enable others to do their best work.

  • Technically deep enough to earn the respect of a highly skilled engineering team, while being equally comfortable influencing and contributing at leadership level

  • Communicate openly and directly, give and receive feedback constructively, and handle challenging conversations with respect.

  • Actively seek out diverse perspectives, build strong working relationships, and contribute to shared goals across teams.

  • Embrace challenges with openness and resilience, set high standards for yourself, and strive to deliver meaningful outcomes.

 

Working Style & Culture at Relation

At Relation, we operate in a matrixed, interdisciplinary environment, where impact is driven through collaboration across scientific, technical, and operational domains. We collaborate, and you will partner with colleagues across multiple teams and projects, contributing your expertise while aligning to shared company priorities. We work together and win together! The patient is waiting!

 

Recruitment Agencies

Please note that Relation does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Resumes should not be forwarded to our job aliases or employees. Relation will not be liable for any fees associated with unsolicited CVs.

data.title: Senior Performance Lead - Trade Acquisition
data.description:
As our next Senior Performance Marketing Lead, Trade Acquisition, you'll take single-point accountability for how we grow trade supply through paid channels. This isn't about hitting numbers someone else set. It's about setting the goals, building the roadmap and owning the strategy that the whole trade acquisition function is measured against. You'll shape how we invest, what we prioritise, and how the acquisition engine evolves over the next 12 to 24 months, working alongside senior stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Product and Finance.

Forget long lists, here’s what you’ll actually spend your time on:

  • Set the paid acquisition strategy: build the annual and quarterly plan that translates our business goals into clear channel priorities, investment and targets, rather than delivering against a plan set elsewhere.

  • Own PPC, paid social, affiliates and remarketing end-to-end, covering strategy, budget, vendor relationships, testing and performance across each channel.

  • Set and own the commercial targets that matter (MQLs, CAC and LTV:CAC), partnering closely with Finance on forecasting, unit models and the business case for new investment.

  • Build a structured test-and-learn roadmap, sequencing initiatives across quarters and spotting risks such as rising CAC or channel saturation before they bite, while exploring new channels and partnerships as we grow.

  • Partner with Sales, Product & CRO, CRM and Data teams to align lead quality, sharpen the acquisition journey and improve attribution and measurement.

  • Report performance to senior stakeholders with a clear narrative on the mid to long-term health of the acquisition engine, not just in-period results, and represent trade acquisition in planning forums.

 

It’s not about ticking every box. It’s about turning up curious, ready to crack on. You’ll do well here if you bring:

  • Experience (or eagerness to grow into) owning paid acquisition strategy across channels like PPC, paid social, affiliates or remarketing.

  • Confidence setting your own targets and owning the trade-offs between growth, efficiency and quality, rather than just delivering against numbers you're handed.

  • Commercial fluency: comfortable building forecasts and business cases, and working closely with Finance on unit economics.

  • A collaborative streak: you're just as happy partnering with Sales, Product, CRM and Data teams as you are deep in a channel dashboard.

We believe great work deserves great rewards. Here’s just a taste:

  • Competitive salary + annual bonus

  • Employee Share Programme

  • Health, well-being and learning support

  • Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme and Cycle Scheme

  • Birthday/Special day leave

  • Buy & sell holiday scheme

  • 1 week’s paid charity leave and much more!


How we’ll get to know each other:

  • Screening call with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners

  • 1st stage interview with Senior Performance Marketing Lead

  • 2nd Stage interview with VP Sales + Sales Manager

  • Final stage interview includes a case study presentation with hiring manager

If this sounds like the place where you can do your best work, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t tick every box
